datasheet.title: 7050X4 Series 100/200/400G Data Center Switches Data Sheet (Arista Networks, 03-0057-27, Aug 27th, 2025)

description: Arista 7050SDX4-48D8 - a fixed 1RU data-centre switch with 48 x 100G SFP-DD ports and 8 x 400G QSFP-DD ports, running EOS. The front carries the SFP-DD cages in two stacked rows, the odd number on top, in four groups of six columns. The eight QSFP-DD cages are four stacked columns between the second and third groups. A lavender strip between the rows carries each SFP-DD cage's number and lamp and an orange one the QSFP-DD cages'. Four system lamps (system, fan, PS1, PS2) are at the top right. The rear carries two hot-swap 1000 W power supplies at the ends and three hot-swap fan modules. It also has the RJ-45 management port, the USB port and the RJ-45 console port. The same panel is ordered with front-to-rear air (-F) or rear-to-front air (-R).

gaps.note: The data sheet's model comparison gives "Hot-swappable Fans 4 (N+1 redundant)" for the 7050SDX4-48D8, 7050SPX4-48D8, 7050CX4-24D8 and 7050CX4M-48D8 in one cell, while the guide draws one 1RU rear (Figure D-1) with three fan modules and one 2RU rear (Figure D-2) with four, and the data sheet's own 1RU rear photograph shows three. The 2RU model has four; this 1RU model is drawn with three, as the guide's figure.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of the 1RU 7050SDX4-48D8's fan count.

gaps.note: Figure C-3 prints "12" where the lower cage of the last column of the third group should read 36, and its vertical model legend appears to read 7050SPX4-48D8, the sibling's number. The port is numbered 36 and the legend set as 7050SDX4-48D8, the caption's model.
Storage temperature -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2) against -40 to 70 C (data sheet). The guide's is in attrs.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of which is current.

gaps.note: The guide's Figures 3-1 to 3-13 are isometric drawings with no measure and the kit guides for KIT-7101, KIT-7101-D and the other spares are not held, so no ear position or rail kit is written.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the mounting bracket position, and the kit guides.

gaps.note: The strips' legends, the small print of the face, the system and fan lamp glyphs and the PS1 and PS2 legends are unreadable in the 829 px figure. The glyphs and the two PS legends are drawn as read; the rest is not drawn.
Which side the latches of the stacked cages face is not visible in the figure. The library's belly-to-belly convention is used (upper cage upright, lower turned 180).
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the stacked cages.

gaps.note: The management block's console symbol is drawn as read; the order of the three ports (management over USB over console) follows the data sheet's rear photograph and figure D-1.

The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis for KIT-GND-EXT-1RU (guide section 4.2, Table 5). No flat figure measures it, so it is not placed.

name: 7050sdx4-48d8

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 4.4 x 47.5 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.7 inches), 10.4 kg (23.0 lbs). Data sheet: 43.99 x 4.37 x 47.46 cm (17.3 x 1.72 x 18.68 in), 23 lbs (10.4 kg). The width: 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 43.99 cm (440.0 here). The height is the data sheet's 43.7 (the guide rounds it to 4.4 cm). The depth is the guide's 47.5 cm (475.0); the data sheet's 47.46 cm is the same figure to a tenth of a millimetre less. 1RU.

colour.note: The front plate is the median of bare-plate pixels in the guide's figure C-3, #b2b5b7; the strips are #8a84d6 and #f5b335.

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7050SDX4-48D8-F and -R ("front-to-rear air, 2xAC" and "rear-to-front air, 2xAC"). The "#" SKU is an order of parts. The data sheet lists no DC SKU and the guide lists no K, M or empty-bay form of this model: the DC configurations are examples with no part number. The DCS-7050SPX4-48D8 (48 x DSFP) is a different front panel and is not modelled (the library has no DSFP cage).

ears.note: NOT MODELLED, as arista/7050dx4-32s: the guide's rack-mounting figures are isometric and carry no measure, and the kit guides are not held. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: storage -40 to 70 C. The storage temperature differs: gap `environment`, the guide's used.

front-legend.note: The figure prints the maker's wordmark at the top left from 2.0 to 22.0 mm across and 2.9 to 6.3 mm down, and a vertical model legend up the left edge. THE WORDMARK IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved over it. The vertical legend is too small to read with confidence and appears to spell the DSFP sibling's number (7050SPX4-48D8), as the figure may be the sibling's artwork; the plain model text of this device, 7050SDX4-48D8, is set (gap `figure-typo`).

front-ports.note: Figure C-3 at 1.884 px/mm across and 1.922 px/mm down, tab centres from a pixel scan. Forty-eight SFP-DD cages (ports 1 to 48) in two stacked rows and twenty-four columns in four groups of six, abutting at the registry's 14.25 mm ganged pitch (tab centres 26.8 px apart); the cage left edges of the groups are 4.8, 93.2, 261.2 and 349.3 mm from the left of the body, and each is std/sfp-dd-ganged (14.25 x 10.4 mm). Eight QSFP-DD cages (49 to 56) in four stacked columns between the second and third groups, 19.0 mm apart (51, 53 and 55 read at 210.7, 229.3 and 248.7 mm), the first cage left edge at 182.2 mm; they are std/qsfp-dd (19.0 x 10.0 mm). The upper row top is 10.0 mm down (10.2 for the QSFP-DD) and the lower row 14.0 mm below it, which is the cage height plus the 3.6 mm strip. The belly-to-belly orientation is the library's convention (upper cage upright, lower turned 180), which is also what the SFP-DD drawings give; the figure is too small to show the latch side.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E and the data sheet ("1+1 hot-swappable"): THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE THREE FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit. The guide draws no blank for an empty bay, so none is modelled.

gate-1-front.note: Figure C-3 passes at 2 percent. The raster is 829 x 232 pixels. The plate between its edges measures 829 px wide and 84 px tall (aspect 9.87), against the data sheet's 439.9 / 43.7 = 10.07, so the figure is near-orthographic. It is used per axis: 1.884 px/mm across (the 440 mm body is the anchor) and 1.922 px/mm down (the 43.7 mm height is the anchor). One pixel is 0.53 mm, so every front position is good to about 0.5 mm, and every one is `estimated` because it is read off a picture and no dimension states it. The cage columns were read from the white port-number tabs by their centres. The registry's own figures corroborate the scale: the tab pitch is 26.8 px, 14.2 mm, against the SFP-DD ganged pitch of 14.25, the QSFP-DD tabs are 35.7 px, 19.0 mm apart, and an SFP-DD cage is 20 px, 10.4 mm tall.

gate-1-rear.note: Figure D-1 as for arista/7050dx4-32s, the only 1RU rear the guide draws: three fan modules. The guide draws the rear generically and does not say which model uses which; the mapping by height and supply count is ESTIMATED. The data sheet says four fans for this model: the gap `fan-count`.

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-24 in the held sources only (the guide and the data sheet, which carry no end-of-sale notice for the 7050SDX4-48D8). Arista's own advisories pages were not reachable from the modelling host.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. Each carries an `empty` sentence. The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis (guide section 4.2, Table 5, KIT-GND-EXT-1RU, which lists the 7050SDX4-48D8); no figure measures it.

port-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.2, Table 10: off the link is down, green link up, yellow software disabled, flashing yellow failed diagnostics. Figure C-3 draws one small green lamp for each port on the strip, the odd port's 3.4 mm left of the column centre and the even port's 3.5 mm right of it (4.3 and 4.6 mm for the QSFP-DD columns); the rows differ by under 1 mm and are modelled on one centreline 22.0 mm down. One lamp a port.

port-numbering.note: Figure C-3 (callout 1, "Port numbers") prints 1 over 2, 3 over 4, and so on across the left two groups, 1 to 24, then 49 over 50 to 55 over 56 in the QSFP-DD columns, then 25 over 26 to 47 over 48 in the right two groups. The odd number is the upper cage. THE FIGURE PRINTS "12" ON THE LOWER CAGE OF THE LAST COLUMN OF THE THIRD GROUP, where the sequence and the caption's strip both read 36; 36 is modelled (gap `figure-typo`). The figure prints each number on a white tab over its cage and, smaller, in the strip with an arrow (up after an odd number, down after an even one). The numerals are set in the strip, left of each lamp. EOS interface names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 4: typical / maximum 165 W / 520 W with PWR-1011-AC or PWR-1011-DC; the data sheet states the same, typical "measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports, excludes transceivers".

rear.note: Figure D-1 as for arista/7050dx4-32s: PS1 left and PS2 right, supplies 73.5 mm wide at 4.0 and 362.3 mm across, the management block 83.0 to 101.0 mm across, three fan modules 78.6 mm wide at 107.7, 191.0 and 274.3 mm.

rear-fan.note: Data sheet "Fan Tray" row for the 7050SDX4-48D8: "FAN-7011M-F" and "FAN-7011H-R" (the cell sits under the first column; the same row gives the 7050CX4-24D8 FAN-7011H-F and FAN-7011H-R). The guide names no fan part number for any model. The front-to-rear build therefore seats the MEDIUM-speed FAN-7011M-F (arista/7280r3-fan-m) and the rear-to-front build the HIGH-speed FAN-7011H-R (arista/7280cr3-fan-rev), and the three fan modules are bays that accept those two. The two are reused from the 7280R3 and 7280CR3 families by part number; no second component is made for either.

speed-strips.note: Figure C-3 draws a lavender strip between the rows under each group of SFP-DD cages and an orange one under the QSFP-DD columns, 20.4 to 24.0 mm down. The strips' small legends (the speed symbols) are not legible in the 829 px figure and are not drawn.

status-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.1, Table 9 and Figure C-3 callouts 2 to 5: a system status lamp, a fan status lamp and a status lamp for each of the two power supplies, as arista/7050dx4-32s. Four lamps in a row at the top right, 412.2, 419.0, 425.9 and 432.8 mm across and 2.6 mm down, each with its symbol or legend to its right; the order is the order of the guide's Figure A-1.

vents.note: The figure shows rows of hexagonal vent holes above the cages (2.9 to 8.8 mm down, from 24 mm across to the lamps) and a band below them (35.0 to 41.3 mm down, the full width). Each is drawn as a vent field in its measured extent; the individual holes, the smaller row under the wordmark and a round mark at 92.9 mm across are not drawn.
